takeaway: Agent security keeps leading. Cloudflare's security-audit skill is up 31% in five days with no announcement found, NVIDIA's OpenShell had a second strong day after launch, and an offensive-security skill library for Claude is now trending.

findings.heading: Cloudflare's security skill: +31% in five days, cause still unknown
findings.text: Measured by the radar from 32,421 stars on Oct 19 to 42,602 on Oct 24 (+2,465 in the last day). No announcement, merged commit, marketplace listing or newsletter mention was found.

findings.heading: NVIDIA OpenShell keeps climbing after launch
findings.text: The open agent sandbox runtime gained 924 stars in a day, to 18,963, its second strong day after NVIDIA's GTC Berlin announcement on Oct 21.

findings.heading: Offensive-security skills for Claude are trending
findings.text: SnailSploit/Claude-Red packages 78 offensive-security skills (SQL injection, EDR evasion, AD attacks) for Claude, with 8.7k stars and no explicit authorization or misuse disclaimer on its page.

findings.heading: morluto/rea is slowing
findings.text: Its measured daily gain fell four days running, from 9,917 to 6,200 stars, and its stated weekly gain dropped to 88,243 as last week's spike ages out. It stays flagged.

findings.heading: Agent compute and app builders keep compounding
findings.text: Runpod reports $325M ARR and 1.2M registered developers, and Base44 reached $200M ARR in August. Both were read from search results.

findings.heading: Every hypothesis raised today was already disproved
findings.text: All 7 rule-generated hypotheses (agent orchestration, generative UI, LLM gateways, agent memory) had been researched and disproved earlier this week. The hypotheses table now shows each verdict.

caveats: Some apps still rank on gains stated up to five days ago, ahead of the radar's own readings that show them cooling.
Every company figure today came from search-result summaries; Horizon3's $100M ARR conflicts with coverage saying it was nearing $100M.
GitHub trending pages list 8 to 21 repos instead of 25, so lower-ranked repos are missed.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
No forecast has matured yet; the first scorecard is expected around Oct 26.
